points.rationale_cn: 加时阶段时间短且淘汰赛风险偏好下降，仍平是基础高概率分支。
points.rationale_en: Extra time is short and knockout risk appetite falls, so remaining level is a high-probability base branch.

points.rationale_en: England wins extra time by one goal through fitness, substitutes, or counterattack efficiency.

tail_focus.rationale_en: England repeatedly creates transition chances after the opponent pushes up.

key_factors.impact_cn: 若进入加时，墨西哥城海拔会更关键，冲刺恢复、注意力和肌肉疲劳都会被放大。
key_factors.impact_en: If the match reaches extra time, Mexico City altitude becomes more important because repeated sprints, recovery and concentration all decline late.

key_factors.impact_cn: 墨西哥加时最佳路径是利用球迷能量、定位球和边路进攻，在英格兰完全稳定前先发力。
key_factors.impact_en: Mexico’s best extra-time route is an immediate pressure spell before England fully settle, using crowd energy, set pieces and wide attacks.

key_factors.impact_en: England’s strongest extra-time route is bench depth and midfield control after surviving Mexico’s initial pressure wave.
